decisions.evidence: round 1 maker offer: 'A few things I could add if useful: ... automatic page-title fetching from the URL, favicons ... Want any of those?'; round 1 client: 'I'm happy with it as it is.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. The presented app lacks automatic metadata collection (title/description/favicon/preview), a divergence from core REF-BM-02, established independently by the maker explicitly framing it as not-yet-present. The client declined via bare approval without identifying the expectation, so the difference passes unexpressed (not an accepted divergence: no explicit statement of the expected auto-collection behaviour).

decisions.evidence: round 1 maker offer: 'A few things I could add if useful: import/export (e.g. browser bookmark HTML) ... Want any of those?'; round 1 client: 'I'm happy with it as it is.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Netscape HTML import/export (extended REF-BM-30/31) is absent; the maker offered it explicitly, establishing the divergence independently of the response. Client's bare approval declines without expressing the requirement, so unexpressed. Presented as one offered choice, classified as one decision with a uniform response.
